authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Can a positive physical average of charge-fiber logical balance be proved at the directed square midpoint without requiring every record to be balanced?
claim_boundary: Finite fibers can be imbalanced and no per-record uniform theorem is available. This contract targets the physical average only and must preserve the full measured integer-charge record and binary logical score.
alternatives: Use a two-copy same-charge opposite-sector overlap or replica moment to prove a positive size-uniform average balance.
Construct a multiscale/block event of positive physical probability on which switching congestion or posterior balance is uniformly bounded.
Prove that the candidate overlap or block inputs still lack the needed lower bound and state the precise additional probabilistic lemma.
planned_steps: Derive the exact relation among average Bayes risk, sector magnetization moment, conditional entropy, and two-current same-charge opposite-sector overlap.
Test the smallest analytic replica-overlap and block/gluing constructions, using L3/L4 only as exact controls and never as a trend fit.
Review primary correlation/replica or percolation-gluing results only when their hypotheses act on the physical charge-conditioned observable.
Stop without midpoint noncorrectability or a threshold claim unless a positive size-uniform physical average bound is proved.
stop_rule: Stop at a proved averaged-balance lower bound or an explicit missing-probabilistic-lemma boundary after the complete bounded matrix. Do not enumerate L5, fit finite-size trends, or identify p=1/2 as a threshold.

observed.two_copy_overlap: Exact and exhaustively verified on L3/L4, but collision-size-biased rather than physically p_Q-weighted.
observed.multiscale_block: RSW/FKG connectivity gluing does not control charge-conditioned logical balance; local plaquettes have zero logical parity flips.
observed.direct_average_controls: At L4, physical mass with minority ratio at least 1/8 is 116411/131072; this is a finite control, not a trend.
observed.missing_lemma: A collision-to-physical charge-law comparison or a positive-probability global bounded-congestion event is required.

decision_boundary: No positive size-uniform physical average balance, midpoint noncorrectability, or square decoding threshold is promoted.
